## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on modernizing the Plone Volto frontend (codenamed "Seven") to comply with current web standards and practices. As the existing frontend architecture is dated, the goal is to rewrite it using newer libraries like React Router 7 while maintaining compatibility with existing Volto sites.

## What needs to be done
You will be involved in transitioning to a new frontend system, which includes:
- Implementing a modern build process with Vite.
- Refactoring various components and creating a new theming system.
- Developing a unified block model for both the public and CMS UI.

## Helpful background
This project is complex and aims to integrate modern development practices while addressing some ambiguity in the discussions, particularly regarding the relationship between the public UI and the CMS UI. Insights from community members indicate that there are ongoing debates about headless versus integrated systems.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing Volto codebase.
2. Review the relevant PLIPs (Plone Improvement Proposals), especially [PLIP 6324](https://github.com/plone/volto/issues/6324) on React Router 7.
3. Set up a development environment using the Seven branch.
4. Begin by addressing smaller tasks or components in the current architecture, ensuring documentation remains a focus as emphasized in the guidelines.
